columns.$description: 4-column phone grid. On larger phones margin is fixed and columns are fluid.

margin.$description: Fixed horizontal margin — stays 16pt at all phone sizes. Measured from profile screen: 361pt content in 393pt frame.

contentWidth.$description: Content width at 393pt reference device (393 - 2 × 16pt margin = 361pt). Reference: iPhone 15/16 logical size.

touchTarget.$description: Minimum interactive touch target — 48pt above the 44pt iOS / 48dp Android floor. Set higher for in-vehicle one-handed use.
